messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — post-launch iteration planning for the v2 widgets rollout. We need to lock down what is a bug vs enhancement and decide what goes in the patch release vs next wave. Propose an async 30m triage window today. Please vote or drop quick takes. :eyes:

Zach (Eng): +1. My suggested rule-of-thumb: P0 = crash/regression or data loss; P1 = clear user-facing break (blocking flow) or >20% perf regression; everything else is enhancement.

Samir (SRE): Add infra signals: sustained tail latency >2s or CPU/GPU >75% for 10m -> bug. Also any increase in 5xx rate >3x baseline -> bug.

Beth (Design): UX call — small polish fixes that are <2 dev-days and don't change flows we should bundle into patch. Anything touching onboarding or modal flows should go to next wave unless it's a regression.

Maya (PM): Good. Proposed labels to use in GH: `bug`, `regression`, `perf`, `ux-small`, `enhancement`. Priority labels: `p0`, `p1`, `p2`. Can we auto-label regressions that mention "regression" or contain stack traces?

Zach (Eng): I can add a lightweight GH action to tag based on title/body heuristics. Example snippet (very small):

```
# .github/workflows/labeler.yml
on: [issues, pull_request]
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/labeler@v1
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
```

Zach (Eng): Will open a PR to add `regression` + `perf` rules.

Maya (PM): To decide scope: please vote using emoji — :one: include in patch, :two: defer to next sprint, :three: needs more info. We'll use majority of p0/p1 to force inclusion.

Samir (SRE): I'll take on infra/perf triage for the patch candidates.

Beth (Design): I'll review any `ux-small` nominees and mark if they actually meet the <2d bar.

Maya (PM): Owners: Zach for engineering fixes, Samir for infra, Beth for UX. I'll own final scope decisions and stakeholder comms.

Maya (PM): Timeline: async triage window closes today 6pm PT. Final scope announced tomorrow EOD. Target patch release: Wed next week (small rollout + canary).

deploy-bot: Deployed canary v2.1.3 to canary cluster at 2029-06-15T10:12:08Z — monitoring enabled.

reminder-bot: Reminder — post-launch triage window closes in 2 hours.

Zach (Eng): Tiny note — let's add an acceptance checklist for patch PRs so we don't regress tracing or metrics. I'll add the checklist to the repo: `checks: tests, perf-smoketest, metrics-gate`.

Maya (PM): Perfect. If anyone has hot customer asks that should interrupt triage, ping me directly. Otherwise please cast votes and I'll publish the final list. :white_check_mark:
